notes.title: Mighty Arms Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[h2]🛠️ [b]Mighty Arms Patch 1.1 is LIVE![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Patch 1.1 has landed, and the construction site is running smoother than ever.[/p][p][/p][p]🔥 [b]What’s Fixed in Patch 1.1:[/b][/p][p]⚡ [b]Generator task stabilized[/b] – The generators now receive damage appropriately and the enemies focus both equally. 
🏆 [b]Achievements unlock properly[/b] – There were some rare occurances where individual achievements were not unlocked. This is now fixed. 
🤖 [b]Enemy AI performance overhaul [/b]– Optimization in the enemies code has bettere performance [/p][p]💥 [b]General performance[/b] - Performance polish applied.[/p]

notes.title: MIGHTY ARMS IS OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h2]💥 Mighty Arms is OUT NOW on Steam![/h2][p]Starting [b]today, August 1st, 2025[/b], you can dive head-first into the most explosive construction brawler ever made.[/p][p]Play as [b]John Builder[/b], the walking wrecking ball with fists of fury, and tear through armies of rogue construction bots gone mad. [b]Elon Fusk[/b]'s machines aren’t just malfunctioning — they’re out for blood. And you're all that stands in their way (or above them, mid-air, mid-punch).[/p][p][/p][h2]🔥 Here’s what you can do RIGHT NOW:[/h2][p]🥊 [b]Wreck with physics[/b] – Every swing, slam, and uppercut is gloriously unpredictable. Chaos is not a bug, it’s a feature.
🤖 [b]Fight absurd robo-enemies[/b] – Hovering drones, drill-bots, and Fusk’s finest death machines.
🔧 [b]Upgrade and go wild[/b] – Launch fists like rockets. Sprint like a caffeinated rhino. Be the destruction.
😵 [b]Meet the weirdos[/b] – Elon Fusk, your boss, and you, possibly the strangest of all.
☕ [b]Sip some coffee[/b] – Even demolition heroes need a quick break between chaos.[/p][p][/p][h2]⚠️ This is not a drill.[/h2][p]You're not here to fix things, you're here to smash them to bits.
Grab your hard hat and [b]jump into Mighty Arms right now[/b]. The construction site will never be the same again.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b]Play it now on Steam[/b]
👷‍♂️ [b]Tell your crew. Bring friends. Throw fists.[/b]
🧱 [b]If you want to support the game further, be sure to leave a honest review![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Watch the release trailer: [/p][previewyoutube="_2wiFDUJof4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support.[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Just another day on the world’s most dangerous construction site. Time to get back to work.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Mighty Arms is about to strike!
